steps.claude:
- Open the **Claude Desktop** app
- Go to **Settings**, then select **Developer**
- Click **Edit Configuration**
- Open the **claude_desktop_config.json** file
- Copy and paste the server configuration into the existing file, then save
steps.cline:
- Open VS Code with the Cline extension installed
- Click the Cline icon in the sidebar
- Select **MCP Servers** from the dropdown menu
- In the **Remote Servers** tab, enter the server name and your MCP server URL
- Click **Add Server** to connect
steps.cursor:
- Navigate to **Settings**, then select Cursor settings
- Choose **MCP** on the left
- Click **Add New Global MCP Server** at the top right
- Copy and paste the server configuration into the existing file, then save
steps.lobeChat:
- Open the **LobeChat Desktop** app
- Go to **Settings** - **Default Assistant**
- Then select **Plugin Settings** - **Custom Plugins**
- Click **Quick Import JSON Configuration**
- Copy and paste the server configuration into the text box, then install
steps.openai:
- Open your **OpenAI app** or development environment
- Configure MCP tools in the **Responses API**
- Add MCP blocks to the **tools** array in API requests
- Set **server_url** to your MCP server endpoint
- Include required authentication headers (API key, token, etc.)
- Use the `allowed_tools` parameter to restrict exposed tools
- Set `require_approval` to control tool execution approval
steps.vscode:
- Open VS Code
- Open the command palette (`Ctrl+Shift+P` / `Cmd+Shift+P`)
- Type **MCP: Add Server** and select it
- Choose to add to workspace or user settings
- Copy and paste the server configuration
